sources.title: byrizki/rusto-rs: Pure Rust OCR Library - GitHub
sources.snippet: RustO! is a pure-Rust Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engine and multi-platform toolkit. Powered by PaddleOCR models and the RTen inference engine (.rten & .onnx), RustO! delivers fast, memory-safe text extraction with zero C++ or OpenCV dependencies.
